NESSgames said:
So I tried to test my game on RPG Maker 2003 but when I test my game for some reason the up key is pressed by it self.
Click to expand...
This problem occurs because you may have a gamepad connected via USB. This doesn't happen in RM2k, but in RM2k3, because it supports the gamepad's
Left Stick
, it interprets them as stuck.
Simply use this tool to modify the buttons:
RM2k3 Input Configurator - reassign keyboard and gamepad functions
Hey folks,  I created this online tool to patch your RPG_RT.exe for custom keyboard and gamepad assignments. This also makes it possible to use 6 buttons on the gamepad (A, B, X, Y, L, R) for different functions and not just 3.  Here you go...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com

I might be mistaken and the problem might actually be with the D-Pad, but I can't test it without a controller right now... sorry

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body:
If
this is because of a gamepad, it would be because of D-Pad. I added D-Pad support to the English RM2k3 version but there was a bug that if a controller doesn't even have a D-Pad then it may incorrectly interpret it as "up" being pressed.
Anyway, this issue also keeps happening for other reasons, and I was never able to fully figure out why, because unfortunately it never happened to myself and every time I asked affected people over the years whether I could remotely troubleshoot it on their machine while it was actively happening, I got denied, so I could never fix it. (If it's not because of the gamepad and you still have this problem, please let me debug it! It would help everyone! Thank you.)

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
It was indeed the D-Pad; I didn't have the gamepad to test it with. Upon testing, I realized this in relation to the AXES:
When the gamepad is only connected, the values become fractional; this might not happen with other games because they convert to whole numbers. But that's just theory...
